key_insight: BAR lets an LLM reason over medical knowledge graphs with a fixed budget while keeping evidence traceable and citable.
clinical_relevance: It may improve post-discharge risk prediction from EHRs by bringing in missing comorbidity and drug-disease knowledge without relying on opaque, uncited reasoning.
method: Builds disease-specific evidence graphs with support scores and provenance for each edge.
Uses an LLM plan-navigate-verify loop to retrieve evidence, check it, and revise when needed under a budget.
Trains a policy with rewards for accuracy, lower acquisition cost, and citation integrity.
evidence_signal: Across 8 diseases and 3 prediction horizons on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, BAR improved AUPRC by 3.4 points, raised citation precision from 59.8% to 77.9%, and used only 62-65% of the budget cap.
watch_item: Performance depends on KG quality and provenance, so real-world deployment will need careful validation that retrieved citations remain accurate and clinically relevant.
paper_title: Cite What You Explore: Budget-Aware LLM Reasoning over Medical KGs with Verifiable Evidence
